<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>Shared Duck.ai Chat</title>
    <meta name="description" content="View a conversation shared from Duck.ai - free, private AI chat by DuckDuckGo. Save it to your own chats and continue privately." />
    <meta name="keywords" content="Duck.ai, DuckDuckGo AI, private AI chatbot, free AI chat, anonymous AI chat, AI chat no sign up, OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral, open source AI models, privacy focused AI, no account AI chat" />
    <meta property="og:title" content="Shared Duck.ai Chat">
    <meta property="og:image" content="/og-image-duckai-share.png">
    <meta property="og:description" content="View a conversation shared from Duck.ai - free, private AI chat by DuckDuckGo. Save it to your own chats and continue privately.">
    
    <meta property="og:site_name" content="Duck.ai">

    <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/favicon-96x96.png" sizes="96x96" />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg" />
    <link rel="shortcut icon" href="/favicon.ico" />
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" sizes="180x180" href="/apple-touch-icon.png" />
    <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Duck.ai" />
    <link rel="manifest" href="/site.webmanifest" crossorigin="use-credentials" />
    <link rel="preload" href="/font/DuckSansProduct-Regular.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin="anonymous" />
    <link rel="preload" href="/font/DuckSansProduct-Medium.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin="anonymous" />
    <link rel="preload" href="/font/DuckSansProduct-Bold.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin="anonymous" />
    <link rel="preload" href="/font/DuckSansDisplay-Bold.woff2" as="font" type="font/woff2" crossorigin="anonymous" />

<script>
try {
    beforeBody();
} catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
}

function beforeBody() {
    if (/^\/share\//.test(location.pathname)) {
        var meta = document.createElement('meta');
        meta.name = 'robots';
        meta.content = 'noindex, nofollow';
        document.head.appendChild(meta);
    }

    document.documentElement.classList.remove('no-js');
    var osDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    var native = window.__nativeStorageEntries;
    var isDesktopElectron = !!window.navigator.duckduckgo && window.navigator.duckduckgo.platform === 'electron';
    var stored = (native && native.setting_kae) || localStorage.setting_kae;
    var isDark = stored === 'd' || (stored !== '-1' && osDark);
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';

    if (isDesktopElectron) {
        document.documentElement.dataset.desktopElectron = '';
    }

    // Expose the OS so CSS can target OS-specific quirks. Match desktop
    // Windows while excluding Windows Phone / Mobile.
    var ua = window.navigator.userAgent;
    var isWindows = /Windows|Win32|Win64/i.test(ua) && !/windows phone|windows mobile/i.test(ua);
    if (isWindows) {
        document.documentElement.dataset.os = 'windows';
    }

    try {
        var sidebarCollapsed =
            (native && native.duckaiSidebarCollapsed) || localStorage.getItem('duckaiSidebarCollapsed');
        if (sidebarCollapsed === 'true') {
            document.documentElement.dataset.sidebarCollapsed = '';
        }
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
        var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (params.get('native-input') === 'true') {
            document.documentElement.dataset.hideChatInputPlaceholder = '';
        }
    } catch (e) {}
}

</script>
